editorNote: A day built from headlines alone: gold and bitcoin both trade around Iran diplomacy, while Alibaba, Rocket Lab, Duolingo and Alphabet each get a headline-level note. Article bodies were not retrievable, so details are limited to what the titles state.

stories.headline: Gold rallies toward $4,200 as US yields retreat, with a report of 'productive discussions' with Iran
stories.summary: Headlines on Friday show gold up about 1.81%, with FXStreet citing a rally to $4,200 as US yields retreat and Yahoo Finance noting modest gains after 'productive discussions' with Iran. Only headlines were available for these reports; no further detail was read.
stories.whyItMatters: Headlines tie the move to lower US yields and Iran diplomacy, continuing the yield-and-geopolitics push and pull on spot gold.

stories.headline: Bitcoin opens at about a three-week low, then crypto stocks rebound as a Trump signal cools Iran attack fears
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's Friday market note says bitcoin and ethereum opened at their lowest levels in about three weeks; Barron's reports bitcoin, Strategy and crypto stocks rebounded after a Trump signal cooled Iran attack fears. Only headlines were available; price levels were not read.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's morning weakness and later rebound were both tied in headlines to Iran-related risk sentiment.

stories.headline: Alibaba ADRs are reported surging as Michael Burry is said to boost his stake
stories.summary: Investing.com asks why Alibaba's ADR is surging on Friday; Stocktwits reports Michael Burry boosted his Alibaba stake and called it China's 'most advanced' AI company, while noting the stock had been stuck. A Moomoo item says BofA kept its Buy rating and raised its target price to $178. Only headlines were available.
stories.whyItMatters: A prominent investor's reported stake increase and a broker target raise are the disclosed catalysts named in headlines.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab pushes 'responsive space' with a four-complex launch network, while space peers slip on a SpaceX spectrum deal
stories.summary: Stocktwits says RKLB jumped overnight as Rocket Lab doubled down on responsive space with a four-complex launch network. Separately, 24/7 Wall St. reports AST SpaceMobile fell 6% as a SpaceX spectrum deal closed off a low-band option, with Rocket Lab and Planet Labs also slipping. Only headlines were available.
stories.whyItMatters: Headlines point in two directions for RKLB: an overnight gain on the launch-network news and a later dip alongside space peers.

stories.headline: Duolingo heads for its best week in over a year; a law firm announces a class action

stories.whyItMatters: The shares' weekly strength and a newly announced securities class action run side by side in Friday's headlines; the lawsuit's allegations were not read.
